definitions.gloss: to start laughing; to burst out laughing
definitions.explanation: To suddenly begin laughing. The action of laughter starting, often implying a spontaneous or uncontrolled onset.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一斉|いっせい}→一斉：01726_issei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{笑|わら}い{出|だ}した。
examples.english: Everyone started laughing all at once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧、{笑|わら}い{出|だ}さずにはいられなかった。
examples.english: When I saw her face, I couldn't help but start laughing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧キャッキャ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{笑|わら}い{出|だ}して、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{釣|つ}られて→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
examples.english: The baby suddenly started giggling, and everyone around couldn't help but laugh along.

examples.japanese: ⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最中|さいちゅう}→最中：02821_saichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{笑|わら}い{出|だ}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{堪|こら}えた→堪える：08995_koraeru⟧。
examples.english: I nearly burst out laughing in the middle of a serious meeting and desperately held it in.

notes:
ASPECT: 〜{出|だ}す marks the onset of an action, so {笑|わら}い{出|だ}す is nearly always used in the past ({笑|わら}い{出|だ}した) or with そうになる ('almost started laughing'). ている is odd with it — for ongoing laughter use ⟦{笑|わら}っている→笑う：00685_warau⟧ instead.

FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to laugh) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to begin).

The 〜{出|だ}す pattern attaches to the masu-stem of a verb to indicate the beginning of an action, usually with a nuance of suddenness or spontaneity that the speaker did not control. Compare 〜{始|はじ}める, which is neutral about suddenness.

PATTERN:
{笑|わら}い{出|だ}さずにはいられない - can't help but start laughing

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
・⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}す→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧ - to start crying
・⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}す→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧ - to start running
・⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}す→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧ - to start raining
・{話|はな}し{出|だ}す - to start talking
